# nullplatform_scopes (Data Source)

Lists the scopes of an application. The API lists deleted scopes too; set `status` to list only scopes in that status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    nullplatform = {
      source = "nullplatform/nullplatform"
    }
  }
}

provider "nullplatform" {}

# The active scopes of an application (the API also lists deleted scopes)
data "nullplatform_scopes" "active" {
  application_id = 1234567890
  status         = "active"
}

output "production_scopes" {
  value = [for scope in data.nullplatform_scopes.active.scopes : scope.slug if lookup(scope.dimensions, "environment", "") == "production"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (Number) ID of the application whose scopes are listed.

### Optional

- `status` (String) Only list scopes in this status, e.g. `active`. When omitted, scopes in every status are listed, deleted ones included.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `scopes` (List of Object) The scopes of the application, ordered by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scopes))
